purpose: Accurate inventory of extracted runtime blocks and their current responsibilities.
policy: Do not split mixed-scope blocks mechanically: they share globals and depend on original script execution order. The extracted files remain referenced at their original positions.

modules.js/core/legacy-main-controller.js: Legacy main controller: maps, geocoding, A/B route, fare, ride request/search/acceptance state, navigation, and driver registration. Mixed responsibilities remain intentionally together because of shared globals.
modules.js/features/customer/ride-booking.js: Safety-page setup; despite folder placement, not the main ride booking implementation.
modules.js/features/customer/customer-home.js: Customer home and agent page/status/funding UI handlers.
modules.js/services/cloud-session-tracking.js: Supabase-backed auth/session, cloud request loading, passenger trip tracking and resume behavior.
modules.js/services/supabase-client.js: Driver settings-related Supabase initialization/behavior block (not a pure client singleton).
Ride-request compatibility fixes and request UI helpers.
modules.js/features/driver/driver-dashboard.js: Driver dashboard and merchant/staff helper block.
modules.js/features/admin/driver-approval.js: Driver approval/request-map block (shared original scope; not admin page-only).
modules.js/features/agent/customer-recharge.js: Published-version menu shortcut visibility and related compatibility code.
modules.js/features/maps/map-controller.js: Driver-code display/utility block; not the primary map controller.

remaining_decomposition: Extract functions into the target service/feature files only after dependency mapping and browser regression tests. Placeholder target files do not contain live business logic.
